articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Dow Jones Futures Loom With JPMorgan, Goldman, Delta, Taiwan Semi Ahead. The stock market is at highs with JPMorgan, Goldman, Taiwan Semi and Delta earnings due. Two huge conferences, inflation data and perhaps a Trump tariffs ruling also are on tap. Related tickers mentioned: DAL, GE, GS, JPM, MS, NVDA, TSM, WFC, ^DJI, ^GSPC, ^IXIC.

articles.title: Walmart and Google bet on AI agents to reshape how people shop online
articles.mainIdea: Walmart and Google bet on AI agents to reshape how people shop online
articles.summary: CoinDesk: Walmart and Google bet on AI agents to reshape how people shop online. The retail giant said a new Gemini integration reflects a broader shift from search-based shopping to AI systems that can act on a customer’s behalf. Related tickers mentioned: GOOG, WMT.
